episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the transformative impact of AI on the real estate industry, emphasizing the importance of relationship-building for agents to remain relevant. The conversation also covers the challenges posed by Zillow's dominance and Compass's strategic acquisitions, urging independent brokerages to consider forming alliances. Additionally, the episode highlights the growing significance of social media in personal branding for agents.
